title: Revert reason encoding (Error(string) / Panic(uint))
why: Checked arithmetic, require/assert and custom errors produce ABI-encoded revert payloads; solang re-encodes them through SCALE and the decoded reason strings may differ (e.g. panic codes vs messages).
hints: Trigger uint overflow/underflow with checked arithmetic (default in Solidity 0.8).
Division by zero, modulo by zero.
require(cond, "custom message") vs assert(cond) vs revert CustomError().
Explicit type cast overflow: int8(-1) to uint8.
